activeTab: When the user opens the extension action on a paper or web page, access the active tab for the capture workflow. Paper_Mind does not continuously monitor the user's tabs.
scripting: Run the bundled extractor in the active page after the user opens the action. Extract title, scholarly metadata, abstract, selected text and main page content for review before saving a paper or clip.
storage: Keep language, model settings, user-supplied API keys, optional local bridge token and migration flags in chrome.storage.local. These credentials are excluded from library JSON exports.
tabs: Read the current tab's title and URL in the capture popup to prefill the saved paper's source details. The implementation queries only the active tab in the current window and does not maintain a browsing-history log.
unlimitedStorage: Allow the local IndexedDB library of papers, notes and saved web clips to grow without the normal extension storage quota. The package also supports migration of previously stored clip-image records.
alarms: Schedule the daily local JSON library backup at 4 PM local time using the extension background worker.
downloads: Save library JSON backups and user-selected clip images to Chrome's downloads directory. Clip archive operations inspect their own download IDs and may remove those entries from the recent-download list; this does not delete the files.
clipboardRead: Read clipboard text only when the user presses Paste clipboard to add notes or a conversation excerpt to a paper. Opening the popup does not read the clipboard.
offscreen: Use the bundled offscreen document for clip-image blob handling and object URLs needed by downloads, because those DOM facilities are unavailable in a Manifest V3 service worker.
https://*/*: Fetch paper metadata, article previews and images from user-selected source websites, and send task text to the user's selected model API. Users can specify their own HTTPS Chat Completions endpoint, so the service origins cannot be limited to a fixed list of model vendors. No remotely hosted JavaScript is loaded.
http://*/*: Support user-selected HTTP source pages and clip-image URLs, local Chat Completions services, and the authenticated bridge at http://127.0.0.1. Remote model API settings require HTTPS; HTTP model endpoints are restricted to supported local hosts.
file:///*: Display clip images previously archived to the user's own downloads directory. This requires the user's separate Allow access to file URLs setting. The extension does not scan the local filesystem.
